title: Spain's official AEMET warnings
scenario: Read Spain's official warnings for a viewed coordinate on an isolated server1 instance. The screenshots show live HTTP responses for the November 21, 2026, 10:36:33 UTC AEMET revision.

steps.title: Check for current coverage with no warnings
steps.instruction: With AEMET_WARNINGS_ENABLED=true, request GET /weather/v000903/coord/40.4168,-3.7038/warnings. Compare sources.state with the warnings array.
steps.caption: Madrid matched Meteoalerta zone 722802. This current snapshot had no warnings at the viewed point.
steps.expected: Use current coverage and an empty list together to identify a checked point with no warnings.

steps.title: Read the applicable official warning
steps.instruction: Request GET /weather/v000903/coord/41.3874,2.1686/warnings. Check the issuer, matched zone and effective, onset and expiry times.
steps.caption: Barcelona matched Meteoalerta zone 690804 and returned one official warning in this snapshot.
steps.expected: Keep issuer credit and timing with the warning. A future onset can be shown as upcoming after the warning becomes effective. Reevaluate source freshness on read.
